In the morning, I have a coffee while watching the rain fall on the rooftops of the city. Then I answer the important messages and get ready for the afternoon meeting with the whole team. At the end of the day, I tidy my desk and note down what is left to do tomorrow.

To make a trip a success, you mostly need to allow plenty of time: pick a small hotel near the station, keep one day free and ask the locals for advice. The best places are often found on quiet streets, far from the big avenues, and nobody there is in a hurry.

I have just read through the minutes of the last meeting. A few details about the budget are missing, but the main points are there. Could you check the figures before we send them out on Friday morning? If anything looks wrong, tell me and I will correct it today.
